messages:
Alex: hey folks — stuck on the train, delayed by an hour. I have the Sun 02:00-10:00 ET oncall window tonight; can someone cover the 03:30-07:30 ET block? I can do a handoff before I lose signal.
Oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary rollout at 04:00 ET to 20% traffic (see #eng-releases).
Mira: I can pick up 03:30-06:00 ET and shadow for the first 15m. @Sam can you take the tail 06:00-09:00 ET?
Sam: I can do 06:00-09:00 ET. Quick ask — any prewarm or cache steps I should run before taking traffic?
Alex: thanks! short handoff notes:
1) Prewarm embeddings/cache: run:
```
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/prewarm -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAGER_TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","type":"embeddings"}'
```
2) Watch the canary rollout at 04:00 ET — if p50 latency > 800ms or error_rate > 2% for 5m, rollback to `redwood-v2-small`.
3) Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/oncall/inference (steps 2.1 -> rollback).
4) Note: there's a non-critical background batch job at 05:45 ET that can spike memory on gpu-pool-3. If you see OOMs, move routing to `eu-pool-1` and notify infra.
Oncall-bot: Canary policy: latency_threshold_ms=800, error_rate_pct=2, rollback_delay_minutes=5.
Jordan: small FYI — we pushed a light perf tweak to kv-cache yesterday; it reduced cold-starts but warmed caches are slightly larger. You may see elevated memory usage until 06:30 ET.
Sam: ack. I'll check pool metrics and prewarm at 05:50 if needed. @Mira can you DM me the pager token before you hand off?
Alex: yes — I'll DM Mira now with the temporary token. If wifi dies I won't be reachable; rely on the notes above.
Mira: will DM the token to Sam at 05:55 ET and paste `oncall status` output here before handing off. I'll also post the small audit of recent alerts (none open).
Sam: perfect. planning to be online by 06:00 ET. Alex, safe travels :train2: — we'll cover this.
Alex: thanks all. leaving the station now. I'll ping once I get settled; if not, assume handoff to Mira->Sam chain. :v:
